Jack Heart, just now: "do the releas". Ship what is built as v0.4.3 now: launch and quote shared pricing (3cf4cdd) and place accounting (e2203c2, c6ceff9). Queued tick placement keeping solo pricing is today's behaviour, not a regression: say so in the release notes and leave it for a follow-up (0.4.4), do not build it before this release. Go straight to gate: full pytest, mypy and ruff, land on loopflowstudio/etude, then cut and publish v0.4.3 to PyPI the way v0.4.2 was released (#129), and confirm `etude-sdk==0.4.3` installs from PyPI. Then report the version so manabot MTG-409 can pin it.
